verdict.rationale: Working Copy's manual documents a built-in Repository Agent, an AI assistant you talk to in conversation. It is described as able to browse files, search content, read and modify files, and commit, pull and push, which matches every element of the story. The evidence is a single brief first-party passage, with no detail on setup, model or provider, permissions or safety controls, and no hands-on or community corroboration. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of agent behavior and configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration that the agent performs these git operations reliably.
